\[
W_5 = \begin{bmatrix}
  100 & 104 & 110 & 98 & 102 \\
  106 & 255 & 0 & 255 & 99 \\
  101 & 0 & 255 & 0 & 105 \\
  97 & 255 & 0 & 255 & 103 \\
  108 & 96 & 107 & 100 & 109
\end{bmatrix}
\]

The center pixel is 255. Its 3x3 window holds only impulses: 0, 0, 0, 0, 255, 255, 255, 255, 255. There z_min = 0, z_med = 255 and z_max = 255, so the median is an impulse too and stage A grows the window.

In the 5x5 window, z_min = 0, z_med = 103 and z_max = 255. Now z_min < z_med < z_max, so stage B runs. The pixel 255 is not strictly below z_max, so it is an impulse and the output is the median, **103**. A plain 3x3 median would give 255 here.
